entries.title: Meshtastic BLE client protocol
entries.description: Matches the Meshtastic service used for the protobuf client API and radio configuration.
limitations: The service does not identify the radio board, node owner, LoRa channel, or network membership. Pairing and application access require separate checks.

entries.title: Polar Measurement Data protocol
entries.description: Matches Polar PMD, the vendor measurement-stream service used by supported Polar sensors and watches.
limitations: This service does not distinguish H10, OH1, Verity Sense or supported watches. Measurement types and recording access depend on device capabilities and firmware.

entries.title: GoPro BLE control and query protocol
entries.description: Matches the Open GoPro control/query, Wi-Fi access-point, or camera-management service.
limitations: This signature does not establish a GoPro model, supported command set, paired state, or camera-control permission.

entries.title: LEGO Wireless Protocol 3 hub
entries.description: Matches the LEGO Wireless Protocol 3 hub service used by compatible hubs.
limitations: The service is shared by several LEGO hub families. Hub type, attached ports, motors and firmware require protocol data.

entries.title: LEGO Wireless Protocol 3 bootloader
entries.description: Matches the separate LEGO hub bootloader service.
limitations: A bootloader service does not establish the hub model, accepted firmware image, or update authorization. This signature performs no firmware operation.

entries.title: Nordic UART-compatible transport
entries.description: Matches Nordic UART Service, a serial-style BLE transport reused by many vendors and projects.
limitations: NUS is a shared transport. It does not identify a Nordic product, a recorder, a command language, or a particular application protocol.

entries.title: Nordic Secure DFU service
entries.description: Matches the FE59 Secure DFU service documented by Nordic.
limitations: The signature does not distinguish bootloader and buttonless-update modes or establish product model, image compatibility, or authorization. No firmware operation occurs.

entries.title: Nordic legacy DFU service
entries.description: Matches the legacy Nordic DFU service UUID.
limitations: This identifies the legacy DFU protocol surface, not a specific board or compatible firmware image. No firmware operation occurs.

entries.title: Nordic Thingy sensor service family
entries.description: Matches a documented Thingy configuration, environment, UI, motion, sound, or sensor-hub service.
limitations: Services identify the Thingy protocol family. The advertisement does not establish a Thingy generation, board revision, enabled sensor or measurement value.

entries.title: Nordic LED and Button sample service
entries.description: Matches the Nordic LED/Button sample protocol service.
limitations: This sample service is reusable in custom firmware. It does not identify a particular development board or establish LED/button state.

entries.title: Nordic Wi-Fi provisioning service
entries.description: Matches the Nordic Wi-Fi provisioning protocol service.
limitations: The service does not identify a specific board, Wi-Fi network, saved credential, or provisioning authorization.

entries.title: MCUmgr SMP management transport
entries.description: Matches the SMP-over-BLE service used by MCUmgr-compatible firmware.
limitations: SMP is shared by multiple RTOS and product families. Supported management groups, authentication, and firmware-update permissions are unconfirmed.

entries.title: micro:bit GATT service family
entries.description: Matches a documented micro:bit accelerometer, magnetometer, button, pin, LED, event, DFU-control or temperature service.
limitations: The service set depends on the installed program. It does not establish micro:bit hardware revision, running application, pairing state, or sensor values.

entries.title: Texas Instruments OAD protocol
entries.description: Matches the TI Over-the-Air Download service with its full vendor UUID.
limitations: OAD is used by multiple TI-based products. The service does not establish SensorTag identity, image compatibility, or update authorization. No firmware operation occurs.

entries.title: TI SensorTag-compatible sensor services
entries.description: Matches a SensorTag sensor service from the documented TI vendor UUID family.
limitations: TI example profiles are reused in custom devices. CC2541 and CC2650 layouts differ; a service match does not validate a sensor reading or identify the board.

entries.title: Adafruit BLE file-transfer protocol
entries.description: Matches the FEBB file-transfer service used by CircuitPython BLE workflows and compatible implementations.
limitations: This service identifies a file-transfer protocol surface, not a specific Adafruit board. File access requires the device workflow and link-security checks.

entries.title: Adafruit sensor and button services
entries.description: Matches an Adafruit temperature, accelerometer, light, gyroscope, magnetometer, button, humidity or barometric service.
limitations: These services are reusable across Adafruit and custom boards. The UUID does not identify a board, measurement unit instance, or active sensor value.

entries.title: Philips Hue BLE light-control service
entries.description: Matches the documented Hue light-control service UUID.
limitations: The service does not identify a bulb model, bridge membership, supported light features, or control authorization.

entries.title: Concept2 Performance Monitor protocol
entries.description: Matches the Concept2 discovery UUID or a PM device-information, control or rowing service.
limitations: The interface reference covers PM5. This signature does not identify the attached ergometer, PM firmware, active workout, or valid measurement stream.

entries.title: Google Fast Pair protocol
entries.description: Matches the Fast Pair service used for accessory discovery and pairing.
limitations: Fast Pair is shared across accessory vendors. The UUID does not identify the model, account owner, existing bond, or Find Hub enrollment.

entries.title: Xiaomi MiBeacon advertisement family
entries.description: Carries FE95 service data with at least the five-byte MiBeacon fixed header.
limitations: FE95 is shared across Xiaomi ecosystem products. Frame-control flags, product ID, optional addresses and encrypted readings are not decoded or authenticated by this signature.

entries.title: Victron Instant Readout advertisement
entries.description: Carries Victron manufacturer data beginning with the documented Instant Readout type byte.
limitations: Manufacturer bytes include company ID 0x02E1 in little-endian order. Encrypted readouts require the per-device advertisement key; this signature does not identify the power-device model or decrypt readings.

entries.title: CircuitPython BLE workflow advertisement
entries.description: Carries the Adafruit creator/creation field emitted by the CircuitPython public BLE workflow advertisement.
limitations: The field identifies a CircuitPython workflow advertisement pattern. It does not identify a board, creator identity, or authorized file/serial access; private bonded advertisements use a different format.

entries.title: SwitchBot BLE communication family
entries.description: Matches the dedicated SwitchBot communication service documented in the vendor BLE API.
limitations: The service is shared by SwitchBot device types. It does not identify a Bot, curtain, lock, sensor or hub model. Shared FEE7 alone is insufficient for this match.

entries.title: Govee temperature-sensor candidate
entries.description: A documented Govee sensor-name prefix accompanies manufacturer bytes used by the public Govee parser.
limitations: Names and manufacturer data are unauthenticated. 0xEC88 alone is insufficient; the name and payload bounds are required. Firmware variants use other encodings, and readings are not decoded by this signature.
